description: This file contains utility functions and setup code for testing and regression fixtures related to a cron service, including creating jobs, managing state, and handling test setup/teardown.

methods.name: setupCronRegressionFixtures
methods.description: Sets up test fixtures for cron regression testing, including temporary directory creation and cleanup.

methods.name: createDeferred
methods.description: Creates a deferred promise with resolve and reject functions.

methods.name: createRunningCronServiceState
methods.description: Initializes and returns a cron service state object with specified jobs and dependencies.

methods.name: topOfHourOffsetMs
methods.description: Calculates a stagger offset in milliseconds based on job ID hash to spread jobs around the top of the hour.

methods.name: createDueIsolatedJob
methods.description: Creates a CronJob object scheduled to run at a specific time with isolated session target.

methods.name: createDefaultIsolatedRunner
methods.description: Returns a mock function for running isolated agent jobs that always resolves with an 'ok' status.

methods.name: createAbortAwareIsolatedRunner
methods.description: Creates a mock runner function that observes abort signals and resolves accordingly, useful for testing abort scenarios.

methods.name: createIsolatedRegressionJob
methods.description: Creates a CronJob object with specified parameters, scheduled at a given time, with isolated session target.

methods.name: writeCronJobs
methods.description: Writes an array of CronJob objects to a specified file path in JSON format.

methods.name: writeCronStoreSnapshot
methods.description: Writes a snapshot of jobs to a file in JSON format.
